title: Script: Ball Reach, Max Power, Infinite Stamina
features:
⚽ REACH (Ball Interaction)

These features manipulate how close the player needs to be to interact with or kick the ball.

    Ball Reach: Allows you to magically kick or take possession of the ball from a distance without physically touching it. It works by forcing the game's internal ball-contact logic to trigger whenever a ball enters your radius.

    Reach Radius: A slider that lets you adjust exactly how far your "Ball Reach" extends (adjustable from 3 to 40 studs).

    Show Reach: A visual aid that creates a transparent colored bubble around your character, showing you the exact size and hit-area of your current reach radius.

🥅 SHOOTING

These features manipulate the game's shot mechanics, modifying charge times and kick physics.

    Full Charge: Instantly charges your kicks to 100% maximum power the moment you shoot, bypassing the normal wind-up/charge time.

    Insane Power: A toggle that overrides the game's default shot limits, allowing you to hit the ball with custom force and angles.

    Power (Slider): Used in combination with "Insane Power", this lets you multiply the physical force of your kicks by up to 10x.

    Height (Slider): Used in combination with "Insane Power", this lets you multiply the vertical angle/height of your kicks by up to 6x.

🏃‍♂️ PLAYER

    Infinite Stamina: Completely stops your character's stamina from draining while running by overriding the game's internal stamina drain rate to zero.
